title: AI Slide Assistant configuration (technical design section 1.2)
description: What administrators configure, read at start-up from CONFIG_FILE. Secrets are never here: they come from the environment (.env). Sections are added as the milestones need them.

public_url.description: Where people open the app, behind the proxy (e.g. https://logus2k.com/slides/). Starts with http:// or https:// and ends with / (checked by app/config.py).

administrators.description: Sign-in addresses of the administrators (spec AD-1), compared without regard to case.

userinfo_url.description: OpenID Connect UserInfo endpoint asked for the person's name with the token the proxy forwards.

photo_url.description: Where the person's photo is downloaded with the same token (Microsoft Graph). Empty: the UserInfo picture.

sign_out_url.description: The proxy's sign-out address; may hold {logout_hint} and {id_token_hint}.

profile.description: Fetch name and photo; false: the name is the start of the address.

trash_days.description: Days a deleted project stays in DATA_DIR/trash.

services.description: The environment's shared services (technical design sections 6.1, 7, 8). Filled in by the milestone that uses each.

cortex_api.description: Cortex's integration API through the proxy's internal service route.

reranker.description: embeddings-server: its /v1/rerank (bge-reranker) scores conversation and document passages against a query.

image_generation.description: An image-generation service with tti_server's API (POST /api/generate, GET /api/stream/{id}, GET /api/image/{id}), e.g. http://tti-web:80. Left out: generate_image is not offered (spec IM-6).

allowed_origins.description: Pages that may open the assistant's live connection (socket.io) besides public_url's own origin, as scheme://host[:port]; without a port, that host on any port (a local install: http://localhost). A browser's connection from any other page is refused (security review M1).
